summary: Top streamer clip channels rarely reply to viewers, with 13 out of 20 channels staying completely silent and the overall channel reply rate sitting around 1%. However, pinning a strong top comment strongly correlates with higher viewer engagement, driving a 1.62x comment lift (lift_top: 1.62 vs 1.0 baseline across 117 videos). When top channels do pin first comments, they heavily rely on open-ended questions (60%) and emojis (100%) to kickstart discussion.
reply_rules: Keep channel replies extremely rare and concise; across 26 analyzed replies, the median word count is just 1.0 (reply_words: 1.0).
Maintain a fast response time when replying to early comments (reply_minutes median: 128.5).
Use single emojis or very short reactions frequently, as emoji usage appears in 73% of channel replies (reply_traits.emoji: 0.73).
Ask short, provocative follow-up questions to prompt viewer responses (reply_traits.question: 0.23).
Keep the tone casual and lowercase when typing brief texts (reply_traits.lowercase: 0.19).
first_comment_rules: Pin an open-ended question about the clip to trigger viewer debates (top_traits.question: 0.60, lift_top: 1.62).
Include an expressive emoji in every pinned comment (top_traits.emoji: 1.0).
Keep pinned comments brief, aiming for around 6 words (top_words: 6).
avoid: Avoid asking viewers to subscribe in comment replies (sub_ask: 0.0 in top comments).
Do not post external links (link: 0.0 across top traits).
Never pretend to be the featured streamer or engage in hostile arguments (hostile: 0.0).
